st: When NVIDIA is worth more than Switzerland

sec.p: In 3 months, NVIDIA took in $57 billion (earning 36 of them, at a 75% margin). Mind-boggling numbers. Let's try to make sense of them.
Why the hype? Because AI is proving economically fruitful.

sec.t: ff.139.3 Where's my flying car (in GTA 6?)
sec.p: All these reflections are back in vogue because of yet another quiet but astonishing model.
